headline: US Backs Negotiation Route in Venezuela Following Machado Return
summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that Venezuela's path toward competitive elections relies on US-backed negotiations rather than public protests, following the return of opposition figure María Corina Machado.
why: Foreign policy stance from the United States regarding Venezuela directly impacts sanctions policies on Venezuelan oil production and international bond restructurings.

impacts.name: Venezuela
impacts.why: Diplomatic negotiations dictate potential sanctions relief and foreign investment in energy sectors.
